class liiontr.kinetics.progress.ThresholdProgress[source]

Bases: ProgressModel

Progress model activated by the state of another reaction.

The wrapped progress model is active only when the remaining fraction of the specified reaction is below a threshold.

__post_init__()[source]

Validate the remaining-fraction activation threshold.

Return type:

None

class liiontr.kinetics.progress.ExponentialInhibitionProgress[source]

Bases: ProgressModel

Progress model with exponential inhibition.

f(alpha, context) =

f_base(alpha, context) * exp(-x)

where x is obtained from a ReactionContext variable.

Temperature Thresholds

Temperature-threshold wrappers for kinetic models.

class liiontr.kinetics.threshold.TemperatureThresholdKinetics[source]

Bases: KineticModel

Kinetic model activated above a minimum temperature.

The wrapped kinetic model is inactive below the specified temperature threshold.

__post_init__()[source]

Validate the minimum activation temperature.

Return type:

None

The rate is zero below the activation threshold.
